how.title: How it works
how.step1: Every day the model forecasts flood risk for each district.
how.step2: Farmers get a free alert in Khmer, with the reason and what to do.
how.step3: Advice is only ever picked from a fixed list of safe actions.

high.question: Should I harvest now?
high.reply: If most of your grain is mature, yes: harvest in the next 1–2 days and dry the paddy on higher ground. If it is not mature yet, move seed and fertiliser to higher ground and wait for our next alert.

medium.question: Do I need to do anything now?
medium.reply: It is not urgent yet. {action} We will message you again if the risk turns High.

low.question: Is it safe to transplant this week?
low.reply: Flood risk stays low for the next 10 days, so you can go ahead. We will alert you if anything changes.

method.title: How exposure is calculated
method.body: Exposure this week = portfolio value in a district × the highest flood probability forecast for that district in the next 7 days. Only districts whose peak reaches Medium or above (≥ 35%) are counted. Summed across districts.
